package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// Pool stands in for some unrelated type that could be given a method returning Queries,
// entirely bypassing NewQueries and whatever scope it was constructed with.
type Pool struct {
	pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// All is the bypass: a method on a foreign receiver that hands back every scope.
func (p *Pool) All() *Queries {
	return &Queries{pool: p.pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}
}
